title: Ashcourt
blurb: A walled kiln yard at noon. Oxblood glaze versus bone china. Takes go back in the fire.
description: English draughts in a sunlit raku yard. Ember is wet oxblood glaze, bone is cooled china. Hop, or send a piece back into the fire. Crown a man and the glaze runs. Hotseat or the yard thinks back.
